index.title: Master Lean Six Sigma
index.lead: A complete path from White Belt to Master Black Belt: 26 modules, 112 lessons, worked examples, calculators, quizzes, and real-world projects across healthcare, retail, manufacturing, IT, banking, and education.
index.certPathLead: Each belt is a complete course, not a short overview. Start at the level that matches your role.
index.feature1Text: Five belts, 26 modules, 112 lessons, and a coverage checklist for every BOK topic.
index.feature2Text: Quick calculators plus a full worksheet for tests, regression, SPC, capability, MSA, and DOE.
index.feature3Text: Belt quiz banks and lesson quick checks with explanations.
index.feature4Text: A full mini-project for every belt, from handoffs to enterprise deployment.

login.intro: Sign in to sync lesson progress, saved project templates, official belt exams, and certificates. If the API is unavailable, the offline demo still works in this browser.
